휴대폰 웹앱을 이 PC에서 휴대폰 크기 창으로 띄워 봐요. 바깥 연결 없: Open the phone web app on this PC in a phone-sized window. It runs only inside this PC with no outside connection; your real sessions appear and the buttons really work.
· PC가 Cloudflare 임시 터널을 바깥으로 열고, 휴대폰 웹앱은:
· The PC opens a temporary Cloudflare tunnel outward and the phone web app comes in through it. No router ports are opened.
· The tunnel address changes every time, so the current address is posted to a secret ntfy.sh channel where the phone finds it.
· Each device gets its own key (token), handed over only for a one-time QR code (10 minutes) or for the right password entered at a copied address. The PC keeps only a fingerprint (hash) of each key and rejects every request without one.
· The phone sends its key or password only after checking the PC's signature. Even if the address leaks and someone sets up a fake server, nothing is sent there.
· When a session waits for approval or a meeting report arrives, the phone gets a notification (if enabled in the phone app).
· Traffic is encrypted with HTTPS but passes through Cloudflare. Turn it off when not in use.
